colors.intro: The tones of the Material 3 palettes, as used by the bg-<palette>-<tone> and text-<palette>-<tone> classes.

icons.failed: The icon list could not be loaded.

grid.intro: The grid has 12 columns. Classes without an infix apply at every width; an infix applies from its breakpoint up:
grid.formly: The dynamic forms use the same classes for their layout:

all.title: All breakpoints
all.description: Equal columns with .col, sized columns with .col-<n>, at every width.

stacked.title: Stacked to horizontal
stacked.description: Stacked on phones, side by side from the sm breakpoint.

mixed.title: Mix and match
mixed.description: Different spans per breakpoint on the same column.

offset.title: Offsets
offset.description: offset-<n> leaves n columns free before a column.

gutters.title: No gutters
gutters.description: no-gutters removes the space between the columns of a row.

helpers.intro: Every helper class of the stylesheet with what it applies. Most also exist per breakpoint with an infix (d-md-none, text-sm-center); spacing sides are logical: l and r follow the text direction.
